name: Desert Surprise
desc: A scoped quest OVERLAY on the classic dungeon (it links 'classic', injects its own content, and reverts to the plain dungeon below its scope). Self-contained: editing THIS folder tailors the quest -- no engine source changes, so it can be shared and a friend plays it against an unchanged game. The errand: sealed orders send you down to a naga's round throne on the third deep; killing Ssirath, the Coiled Crown unleashes her snake brood up the way out.
